node.title: Re: Get most recent data based on a date from an array of hashes.
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
One way might be to parse the dates via [doc://Time::Piece] into a new value into the hashes and then sorting based on that, e.g.

$_->{TimePiece} = Time::Piece->strptime($_->{Date}, '%m-%d-%Y') for @$data; my @filtered = sort { $a->{TimePiece} <=> $b->{TimePiece} } @$data;

Fetching the most recent result out of the array and [doc://delete|removing] the TimePiece key back out of the hash left as an exercise to the reader.
